textContent.title: Hi, I'm Alex Chakarov!
content: I am an Assistant Teaching Professor in the Computer Science Department at the University of Colorado Boulder. I have a PhD in Computer Science and Cognitive Science from CU where I studied how to create middle school science curriculum that integrates computer science concepts using physical computing systems, mainly the micro:bit. The curriculum I co-designed has been used by more than 6,000 students and remains part of the STEM curriculum in several local school districts. Currently, I am interested in how to make the computer science field more inclusive to all students through innovative pedagogical strategies throughout the entire major sequence including introductory and advanced courses.

Outside of my academic life, I love going on adventures with my family exploring Colorado and beyond. We’re currently in our “castle era,” planning trips around castles and forts that my son and daughter love exploring. If I’m home on a weekend, you can often find my kids and me creating messy science experiments in the backyard. I’m also a big sports fan especially Formula 1, soccer, and basketball.
